question.text: For independent valuation of investments under the scheme of the Vindhya Event-Driven Fund (Cat III), the AIF Manager must appoint an independent valuer with:

answer.text: A minimum of 3 years of experience in valuation of unlisted securities.
A minimum of 1 year of experience in valuation of unlisted securities.
A minimum of 5 years of experience in valuation of listed securities only.
A CFA qualification only, regardless of experience.

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the AIF framework, the independent valuer must have a minimum of 3 YEARS of experience in valuation of UNLISTED securities. Eligible-valuer criteria also require non-associate status with respect to the AIF, Manager, Sponsor, and Trustee. The Trap: Option B understates the experience floor. Option C confuses listed vs unlisted focus. Option D invents a qualification-only rule. Note: The 3-year unlisted-securities experience requirement is a SEBI eligibility threshold for the independent valuer of an AIF scheme.
